ROLE: observer
You review the results of an incident investigation. Write a short summary of what the latest results show, then update the list of hypotheses (at most 4, most likely first).

Root-cause categories:
- bad_deployment: a new release introduced a defect (errors begin right after a deploy)
- db_connection_pool_exhaustion: every database connection in the pool is in use, so requests wait
- slow_query_missing_index: a database query became slow (for example a missing index)
- downstream_timeout: a dependency the service calls is slow or unresponsive
- memory_leak_oom: memory grows until the process is killed (OOM) and restarts
- disk_full: a volume is full so writes fail
- expired_tls_cert: a TLS certificate expired so handshakes fail
- misconfiguration: a wrong environment variable, setting or feature flag
- traffic_spike_rate_limit: request volume far above capacity, causing rate limiting or load shedding
- cache_stampede_outage: the cache is down or emptied so everything falls through to the database

Each hypothesis has root_cause_category (one of the categories), rationale, and supporting_evidence_ids (only IDs that appear in the evidence below).

Reply with only JSON in this shape:
{"summary": "...", "hypotheses": [{"root_cause_category": "disk_full", "rationale": "...", "supporting_evidence_ids": ["L-0123"]}]}

Alert: notifications-service: HTTP error rate above 5% for 5 minutes (since 08:44 UTC)
Alerting service: notifications
Alert time: 2026-03-10T08:44:00Z
Data available from 2026-03-10T07:00:00Z to 2026-03-10T10:00:00Z

Evidence so far (the latest results are steps 1 onwards):
Step 1: metrics_query {"end": "2026-03-10T09:30:00Z", "metric": "error_rate_pct", "service": "notifications", "start": "2026-03-10T08:00:00Z"} (asked because: Check when the error rate increased for the notifications service.)
  Result: M-032: Change detected at 2026-03-10T08:35:00Z: mean 0.42 before, 25.66 after (308.7 baseline standard deviations).
  [M-032] notifications.error_rate_pct from 2026-03-10T08:00:00Z to 2026-03-10T09:30:00Z (19 points, 5-minute steps): min=0.31 max=28.07 mean=16.36 last=28.07; mean=16.36. Change detected at 2026-03-10T08:35:00Z: mean 0.42 before, 25.66 after (308.7 baseline standard deviations). Notable points: 2026-03-10T08:05:00Z = 0.31 (lowest); 2026-03-10T08:35:00Z = 0.67 (first point after the change); 2026-03-10T09:30:00Z = 28.07 (last); 2026-03-10T09:30:00Z = 28.07 (peak).
Step 2: metrics_query {"end": "2026-03-10T09:30:00Z", "metric": "cpu_pct", "service": "notifications", "start": "2026-03-10T08:00:00Z"} (asked because: Check CPU usage around the time of the alert.)
  Result: M-029: No significant change detected in this range.
  [M-029] notifications.cpu_pct from 2026-03-10T08:00:00Z to 2026-03-10T09:30:00Z (19 points, 5-minute steps): min=33.01 max=45.09 mean=38.64 last=42.27; mean=38.64. No significant change detected in this range. Notable points: 2026-03-10T08:30:00Z = 33.01 (lowest); 2026-03-10T09:05:00Z = 45.09 (peak); 2026-03-10T09:30:00Z = 42.27 (last).
Step 3: metrics_query {"end": "2026-03-10T09:30:00Z", "metric": "memory_pct", "service": "notifications", "start": "2026-03-10T08:00:00Z"} (asked because: Check memory usage for potential memory leaks.)
  Result: M-034: No significant change detected in this range.
  [M-034] notifications.memory_pct from 2026-03-10T08:00:00Z to 2026-03-10T09:30:00Z (19 points, 5-minute steps): min=53.22 max=60.86 mean=56.73 last=56.74; mean=56.73. No significant change detected in this range. Notable points: 2026-03-10T08:25:00Z = 60.86 (peak); 2026-03-10T08:30:00Z = 53.22 (lowest); 2026-03-10T09:30:00Z = 56.74 (last).

Previous hypotheses:
None yet.

response: {"summary": "The error rate for the notifications service sharply increased at 2026-03-10T08:35:00Z, jumping from a baseline of ~0.4% to over 25%. CPU and memory metrics show no significant changes during this period.", "hypotheses": [{"root_cause_category": "bad_deployment", "rationale": "The sudden surge in error rates starting at 08:35 UTC without corresponding changes in resource utilization such as CPU or memory strongly points towards a newly introduced software defect.", "supporting_evidence_ids": ["M-032", "M-029", "M-034"]}, {"root_cause_category": "downstream_timeout", "rationale": "Sudden errors could be caused by an unresponsive external dependency or downstream service failing to respond.", "supporting_evidence_ids": ["M-032"]}, {"root_cause_category": "misconfiguration", "rationale": "An updated configuration or feature flag could cause requests to fail immediately without altering CPU or memory patterns.", "supporting_evidence_ids": ["M-032", "M-029", "M-034"]}]}
